lines.text: Unit 06TheModern World
WhatIhavelearned
Europeans went on voyages of discovery to find alternate sea routes fortrade
withAsia.:
Christopher Columbus and Vasco de Gama are two European explorers who
took voyages to reach India to find spices and other goods demanded in
Europe.
The Renaissance or the rebirth of classical learning was a period of
intellectual and cultural progress during the 14th and 17th centuries.
The Reformation is a religious reform period in Europe started in 1517when
Protestants splitfromtheCatholic Church.
The Thirty Years' War was-fought among Protestant and Catholic states in
Europeand lastedbetween1618and1648.
Scientific Revolution is the periodof change in scientificthoughtthattook
placeduringthe16thand17thcenturies in Europe.
The spirit of the Renaissance and the Reformation led to the Scientific
Revolution,whichmadepeopleto reconsider the universefroma different
point of view.
The Industrial Revolution is the period between the 18th and 19th centuries,
where significant changes occurred in technology, manufacturing, and
agriculture.
The Age of Enlightenment or the Age of Reason was an intellectual and
philosophical movement,continued during 17thand18thcenturies.
-The French Revolution was a political and social movement of the French
people against the monarchy that started in 1789 and continued till 1799.
TheNapoleonic Warswerea series of wars thatwere foughtbetweenFrance
and a number of European nations, during Napoleon Bonaparte's rule
between1799and1815.
Nepoleonic Code was a French Civil Code enacted in 1804 by Nepoleon.
The code ensured equality of all citizens before the law, property rights,
and religious liberty.
